title: Comparisons with Mercedes S-Class and Audi
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly reference Mercedes, especially the S-Class, as a comparison point for comfort, driving feel, luxury, safety features, cooling, and EV range, with many mentions lacking a clear sentiment about the compared vehicle.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the vehicle is more fun to drive or more comfortable than a Mercedes S-Class, and one comment says BMW should emulate Mercedes handling.

negative.summary: The lone negative review says a Mercedes S-Class had superior collision-avoidance behavior by stopping before impact.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention prior Mercedes ownership or shopping comparisons with Mercedes and Audi, with a few references to cooling systems, EV range, or luxury impressions that do not clearly resolve sentiment for this topic.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the topic is dominated by brand-comparison mentions without clear evaluative sentiment.
The examples focus heavily on Mercedes S-Class comparisons, but the keyword set also includes Audi and the sample provides limited concrete Audi-specific detail.
